rounds.title: Overlap estimator saturated at 4x and clipped to 1.0
rounds.hypothesis: The parent helper returns at most N correspondences but divides by a 4N probe count, so reported overlap is min(1, 4*true_overlap); pairing a low/mid/high study on it would label almost every pair high.
rounds.change: Added an uncapped overlap_fraction() to full_common.py and used it for all-pair scanning; the parent loader is untouched.
rounds.rationale: The uncapped estimator spreads pairs over the full range, so the three bins are populated in every scene.

rounds.title: gt.log direction verified on the four new scenes
rounds.hypothesis: The stored 4x4 maps id2->id1 on the four new scenes exactly as on the four existing scenes, so the runner's inversion is correct.
rounds.change: Re-ran the direction check for all eight scenes, not just the original four.
rounds.rationale: Forward median is 6-12x the inverse median and 100% of pairs agree.

rounds.title: High-overlap pair selection uses the uncapped overlap
rounds.hypothesis: Fixing the overlap metric changes which 8 pairs are called 'high overlap', so the full table should not silently inherit the old capped-metric selection.
rounds.change: run_full_scenes.select_pairs ranks pairs by uncapped overlap (2000 probes).
rounds.rationale: All selected pairs have high uncapped overlap; the change is documented so the full table is not mistaken for a byte-identical rerun of the parent.

rounds.title: Eight-scene high-overlap table
rounds.hypothesis: The parent two-scene conclusion (GNC matches RANSAC success at 0-70% random outliers while being ~30x faster) holds on the full official set.
rounds.change: Ran the identical protocol on all eight official scene-fragment sets.
rounds.rationale: Success and speedup are stable on the four unseen scenes; coherent outliers at 60% defeat every method as predicted by identifiability.

rounds.title: Clean geometry degrades at low overlap
rounds.hypothesis: Lower-overlap pairs have more boundary/noisy GT-NN pairs, so the fraction of base pairs inside c and the clean registration accuracy should fall with overlap.
rounds.change: Measured base inlier fraction and clean pose error by overlap bin.
rounds.rationale: Reported with the caveat that base matches are oracle GT-NN, so this captures real residual composition rather than front-end failure.

rounds.title: Is the GNC advantage overlap-dependent?
rounds.hypothesis: If GNC's advantage comes from its robust kernel, it should shrink at low overlap where base residuals are larger and closer to c.
rounds.change: Compared GNC vs RANSAC-1000 success and runtime in each overlap bin.
rounds.rationale: Success is at or near saturation in all bins for both methods, so the measured overlap dependence is in rotation error/runtime rather than success; the exact McNemar counts and the low-vs-high interaction CI are in results/overlap_dependence.json.
